nodes.description: msg.sender - caller address used for ownership assignment and initial mint recipient
block.timestamp - used for early sell tax window, LP burn timing and swap deadlines
tx.origin - used as key in _holderLastTransferTimestamp anti-bot one-purchase-per-block check
Ownable._owner - privileged address controlling onlyOwner functions
Reentrancy guard flag set around swapBack call in _transfer
marketingWallet - recipient of low-level ETH call at end of swapBack
devWallet - recipient of low-level ETH call inside swapBack
maxTransactionAmount - per-transaction cap enforced in _transfer
swapTokensAtAmount - contract balance threshold that triggers swapBack
maxWallet - per-wallet holding cap enforced in _transfer
percentForLPBurn - percentage of LP pair balance auto-burned (basis 10000)
lpBurnEnabled - flag allowing automatic LP token burn
lpBurnFrequency - minimum interval between automatic LP burns
lastLpBurnTime - timestamp of last automatic LP burn
manualBurnFrequency - cooldown between manual LP burns
lastManualLpBurnTime - timestamp of last manual LP burn
limitsInEffect - gates max transaction/wallet and trading checks
tradingActive - enables/disables trading in _transfer
swapEnabled - gates automatic swapBack execution
enableEarlySellTax - turns on elevated early seller tax logic
_holderLastTransferTimestamp - tx.origin keyed map storing last transfer block
_holderFirstBuyTimestamp - map storing holder first buy timestamp for early sell tax
_blacklist - map of addresses blocked from transferring
transferDelayEnabled - gates one-purchase-per-block anti-bot check
buyTotalFees - total fee percentage applied on buys
buyMarketingFee - marketing share of buy fees
buyLiquidityFee - liquidity share of buy fees
buyDevFee - dev share of buy fees
sellTotalFees - total fee percentage applied on sells
sellMarketingFee - marketing share of sell fees, mutated for early sellers
sellLiquidityFee - liquidity share of sell fees, mutated for early sellers
sellDevFee - dev share of sell fees
earlySellLiquidityFee - elevated liquidity fee for early sellers
earlySellMarketingFee - elevated marketing fee for early sellers
tokensForMarketing - accumulated tokens allocated to marketing
tokensForLiquidity - accumulated tokens allocated to liquidity
tokensForDev - accumulated tokens allocated to dev
_isExcludedFromFees - map of accounts exempt from transfer fees
_isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount - map exempt from max transaction/wallet caps
automatedMarketMakerPairs - map marking AMM pair addresses
uniswapV2Router - immutable router used for swaps and liquidity
uniswapV2Pair - immutable created pair address
_totalSupply - ERC20 total supply used for constructor allocations and bounds
DHOLD constructor - configures router, pair, fees, wallets and mints total supply
receive() external payable - accepts ETH from router swaps
enableTrading - onlyOwner, turns trading and swapping on
removeLimits - onlyOwner, disables limit checks
disableTransferDelay - onlyOwner, disables transfer delay anti-bot
setEarlySellTax - onlyOwner, toggles early sell tax
updateSwapTokensAtAmount - onlyOwner, changes swap trigger threshold with bounds
updateMaxTxnAmount - onlyOwner, updates max transaction amount
updateMaxWalletAmount - onlyOwner, updates max wallet amount
excludeFromMaxTransaction - onlyOwner, toggles max transaction exemption
updateSwapEnabled - onlyOwner, toggles automatic swap
updateBuyFees - onlyOwner, sets buy fee components with 20% cap
updateSellFees - onlyOwner, sets sell fee components with 25% cap
excludeFromFees - onlyOwner, toggles fee exemption
blacklistAccount - onlyOwner, blocks/unblocks an address
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair - onlyOwner, adds AMM pair other than the main pair
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair - private internal pair flag setter
updateMarketingWallet - onlyOwner, changes marketing wallet
updateDevWallet - onlyOwner, changes dev wallet
_transfer - core transfer logic with limits, taxes, swapBack and LP burn triggers
swapTokensForEth - private, approves and swaps tokens to ETH via router
addLiquidity - private, approves and adds ETH/token liquidity to router
swapBack - private, swaps accumulated fees and distributes ETH to dev and marketing
setAutoLPBurnSettings - onlyOwner, configures auto LP burn frequency/percent
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens - internal, burns part of pair balance and syncs pair
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens - onlyOwner, burns part of pair balance with cooldown
renounceOwnership - onlyOwner, sets owner to zero
transferOwnership - onlyOwner, transfers ownership to newOwner
low-level call forwarding ETH to devWallet inside swapBack
low-level call forwarding remaining ETH balance to marketingWallet inside swapBack
uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens external call
uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH external payable call
IUniswapV2Pair.sync() external call after LP token burns
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership
account parameter of excludeFromFees / blacklistAccount
excluded boolean parameter of excludeFromFees
updAds address parameter of excludeFromMaxTransaction
isEx boolean parameter of excludeFromMaxTransaction
newNum parameter of updateMaxTxnAmount / updateMaxWalletAmount
tokenAmount parameter of addLiquidity
ethAmount parameter of addLiquidity
percent parameter of manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens
from address parameter of _transfer
to address parameter of _transfer
amount parameter of _transfer
local fees accumulator computed in _transfer
local contractBalance read at start of swapBack
local isBuy flag derived from from == uniswapV2Pair in _transfer
local amountToBurn computed in autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens and manual burn
local path array built in swapTokensForEth

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned as _owner in the Ownable constructor, granting privileged control
constructor mints the entire total supply to msg.sender
tx.origin is used in the _transfer transfer-delay anti-bot check
tx.origin is written as the key into _holderLastTransferTimestamp
block.timestamp drives early sell tax branching and LP burn due check in _transfer
block.timestamp is stored into _holderFirstBuyTimestamp for the early sell window
block.timestamp sets lastLpBurnTime inside autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens
lastLpBurnTime is updated from block.timestamp
block.timestamp cooldown check and lastManualLpBurnTime update in manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens
lastManualLpBurnTime is written from block.timestamp
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline argument to the router
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline argument

onlyOwner modifier gates updateSellFees on _owner

onlyOwner modifier gates updateDevWallet on _owner

onlyOwner modifier gates renounceOwnership on _owner

_transfer sets the swapping guard then calls swapBack, which performs external ETH transfers
_transfer triggers autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens when the LP burn interval elapsed
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert accumulated tokens
swapBack calls addLiquidity for the liquidity portion of ETH
swapBack performs a low-level ETH transfer to devWallet
swapBack performs a low-level ETH transfer of remaining balance to marketingWallet
swapTokensForEth invokes the router swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens
addLiquidity invokes the router addLiquidityETH payable function
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() after burning LP tokens
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() after burning LP tokens
constructor sets the AMM pair through the internal setter
constructor excludes owner, contract and dead address from fees
constructor excludes router, pair, owner and dead address from max transaction caps
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates flag writing to _setAutomatedMarketMakerPair
ETH transfer to devWallet executes an external call that can reenter swapBack before state accounting ends
ETH transfer to marketingWallet executes an external call that can reenter swapBack
malicious devWallet fallback can reenter _transfer while the swapping guard is only partially applied
pair.sync() external call can reenter the burn path while pair balance state is being updated
uniswapV2Router immutable is set in the constructor
uniswapV2Router is used as the swap target in swapTokensForEth
uniswapV2Router is used as the liquidity target in addLiquidity
uniswapV2Pair balance is read to compute the automatic burn amount
uniswapV2Pair balance is read to compute the manual burn amount
marketingWallet address is the recipient of the low-level ETH call in swapBack
devWallet address is the recipient of the low-level ETH call in swapBack
tokensForLiquidity drives the liquidity token division and reset logic in swapBack
tokensForMarketing drives ETH distribution arithmetic in swapBack
tokensForDev drives ETH distribution arithmetic in swapBack
swapTokensAtAmount caps the contract balance processed by swapBack
totalSupply is used to bound the new swap threshold value
maxTransactionAmount is enforced on buy and sell transfers
maxWallet is enforced against recipient balance in _transfer
_holderLastTransferTimestamp is read for the per-block transfer delay check
_holderFirstBuyTimestamp is read to decide whether the early sell tax applies
_blacklist is checked for both from and to before transferring
swapping flag is read and written around the swapBack call, as the reentrancy guard
swapEnabled gates whether swapBack is executed during a transfer
buyTotalFees is used in the buy fee multiplication and division
sellTotalFees is used in the sell fee multiplication and division
sellMarketingFee is rewritten for early sellers and used in fee math
sellLiquidityFee is rewritten for early sellers and used in fee math
limitsInEffect gates the max transaction/wallet enforcement block
tradingActive gates transfers from non exempt accounts
transferDelayEnabled gates the tx.origin one-purchase-per-block restriction
enableEarlySellTax gates the early sell tax branch in _transfer
lpBurnEnabled is checked before triggering the automatic LP burn
lpBurnEnabled flag controls automatic LP burning
percentForLPBurn is multiplied and divided to compute amountToBurn
lpBurnFrequency is compared against block.timestamp to decide when to burn LP

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is only meaningful as the ownership transfer target consumed by transferOwnership
account is only used as the mapping key set by excludeFromFees
excluded is the boolean flag written by excludeFromFees into _isExcludedFromFees
updAds is the address key written by excludeFromMaxTransaction
isEx is the boolean value written by excludeFromMaxTransaction
newNum is validated and scaled into maxTransactionAmount inside updateMaxTxnAmount
tokenAmount is approved and forwarded to the router by addLiquidity
ethAmount is the payable value forwarded by addLiquidity
percent bounds the burn calculation performed inside manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens
from is the source address of the core transfer logic in _transfer
to is the destination address whose balance and pair status drive _transfer logic
amount is the transferred value on which limits and fees are computed in _transfer
fees is a transient accumulator fully resolved inside a single _transfer call
contractBalance is a transient snapshot consumed entirely within swapBack
isBuy is a temporary branch selector computed and consumed in _transfer
amountToBurn is a transient value produced and consumed within the same burn function
path is a temporary swap route array used only inside swapTokensForEth
